entities.name: Federalism & Confederalism
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The principle of dividing sovereignty between a central authority and constituent political units. Federalism emerged as a practical compromise between unitary states and loose confederations, enabling diverse communities to share governance while retaining local autonomy. The American, Swiss, and German federal systems became models studied worldwide.
